contributions.statement: In public spec-driven repos, 81% of PRs that touch a spec also touch code, so spec and implementation usually move together in one PR.
contributions.evidence: Table I: 81.2% of 5,992 spec-touching PRs (581 repos, >=10 stars) also modify code; authors call co-change a heuristic, and the sample excludes code-only PRs that skip the spec, so spec drift is not measured.
relative_to: SDD prescription that spec and code change in the same PR

reason: A dataset description with no outcome measure; it cannot say whether SDD improves anything, and the one behavioural statistic is a heuristic restating SDD's own prescription. Useful as reference templates, not as evidence.
